title: It Works, but I've Had Better
text:
It Works, but I've Had Better. We use candles in my household with a good deal of frequency. Scents are what attract us to a specific candle more than anything else and since I like the scent of coconut and pineapple, I decided it was a good idea to get the Homesick Scented Candle Poolside Pina.

This candle is a little smaller than others in our house. It burns clean and from the box, it smells pleasant. These are among the features that matter most to me in a candle. The natural soy composition is a plus, too.

Once lit, the scent emitted by this candle is not as strong as expected. I still find it good enough, but I was hoping for more. But the greatest strike against this candle, at least to me, is the lack of a lid. It is always nice when you can snap a heavy lid in place to protect your candles and store them, but there is no such lid on this candle. Another issue I have, although it’s less important, is the lack of an attractive label. All you get is a plain, black and white label with the name and a few facts.

We have candles throughout the house and Homesick Scented Candle Poolside Pina has found a permanent home on the bar between my kitchen and family room. It works, I suppose, but it isn’t one of the better candles I have owned/used.
